up: Retrieve the exact activity measurements and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4808150. For each activity record, include the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard relation (must be '=' for exact values), standard value, and standard units. Exclude records where standard relation is not '=' or standard value is NULL. The assay is identified by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4808150'.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4808150' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
